'''Armored eels''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] native to the sluggish rivers of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWE" /> One armored eel was present when [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] arrived on Yavin 4 following his defeat during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="The Fall of the Sith Empire 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Naturalist/Legends|naturalist]] [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]] discovered the species. He observed and sketched the eel but didn't record detailed characteristics before his [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWE" />
